  • Available in different sizes, 25 cm thick. The mattresses are available in the sizes 90 x 200, 120 x 200, 140 x 200, 160 x 200 and 180 x 200 cm, all with a thickness of 25 cm – the optimal height according to ergonomics and sleep medicine. They provide differentiated support for different areas such as the shoulders, waist and hips, helping the spine to maintain its natural physiological curvature in the lateral and supine position.
  • 7 individually wrapped feathers ensure undisturbed sleep. Each spring is individually wrapped to provide precise 7-zone support: the head, shoulders, waist, hips, thighs, calves and feet respond to pressure in different zones.   • There is a wave-shaped, breathable sponge layer over the feathers: the textured surface improves microcirculation, wicks away moisture and heat, preventing heat build-up in summer and moisture in winter. The gentle massage effect promotes microcirculation in the subcutaneous tissue and relieves muscle tension. As a transitional layer, it softens the firm support of the springs and thus provides more lying comfort without impairing the support effect.
  • The filling, which comes into direct contact with the body, is made of glue-free cotton: since no chemical adhesives are used, the mattress is formaldehyde-free and odorless. Soft and fluffy, it increases comfort and improves breathability. Particularly suitable for seniors, children and people with sensitive skin, it allows carefree sleeping without clothes.
  • The mattress is equipped with two high-strength handles on each side (four in total): this allows the mattress to rotate regularly and prevents punctual pressure points that can lead to coolness. Changing the bed linen, changing or adjusting the direction of the bed can be easily done by one person. The handles are robust, neatly sewn, tear-resistant and extremely resilient.

Product Overview

Two looks in one! This reversible gingham duvet cover set features a classic check pattern on one side and a solid color on the other, so you can switch up your bedroom style in seconds. Made from premium 90GSM 100% polyester microfiber with a smooth zipper closure, the set is finished with a stylish fabric label at the bottom right corner of the duvet cover and pillowcases. Available in Yellow Small Check and Khaki Small Check, in 6 sizes from Single to UK Super King.

Key Features
